egypt & 10 hits

israel was inside egipt. israel was building egypt cities.
israel was in the midth of the egyptian colture.
israel admiered the egyptian colture.

how can one remove israel from egypt ?
when talking of such coltural changes, one can't force a change
on the basis of sheer power.

forcing a physical change upon a spiritual system will not
result the straight-ahead change that one could expect,
and back to israel, if one had tried to pool them out by
sheer power, he would have a confiused nation, located on
a physical desert, but on the spititual egipt. hey, israel
would try to build ra'amses on the desert...

so, a smooth, coltural action is to be taken.
say, 10 coltural steps.

there is a major difference between old and new coltures.
old coltures are usualy more stable.

take the democratic system. it has developed a strong structure :
the constitutional, justice, and enforcement.
all people on the democracy are aware of the other's right of
having different thoughts.

this is a stable system, that was developed slowly.
it was developed, with pauses, through history.

a culture that wants to stay stable, should change its structure
gradualy. every step of change should keep the values of the
older structure. if the change is too rapid, the colture may
become 'young', and unstable.

fortunately, old coltures usualy posses the tools to prevent
such things.

how do one get israel off egypt ?

in a step-wise maner. first, he give egypt a great growth.
he vitalize egypt, and make it adopt new, radical ideas, that
advance the culture to be more moral, humane, and justice.
one makes sure that this change will be big enough to move
the egyptian colture to the new way of thinking, to the new
colture, without holding back to the old tradition.
one make the egiptian colture young.
collapsing a young colture is like touching a tower of cards.

the life-cycle of the colture is made of two cyclic steps -
day and night.

day - for developing new ideas. on daytime, the nation is more
vital. changes are made, some old concepts are re-checked,
and, maybe, abandoned.

night - the nation is less vital. the changes made at daytime
are tested on the day-to-day, shineless routine.
changes made at day, may be abolished.

after a cycle of day-night, the colture was developed, but not
drasticaly. the face of the colture was changed a little, and
the colture stayed old and stable.

A. dam. "the blood is the soul" ( hadam hu hanefesh ).
first step is to pour vitality and strength in the
egyptian colture.
this may be of no specific result.
the change is on the general : grouth in the coltural
life. more books, phylosophical articals, political
discutions, self moral tests, and the winds of change.

B. tsfardea. tsfar - dea. tsfar - morning. dea - knoledge.
this morning-of-knoledge spirit is similar to step A,
but more specific. first fruits of the coltural rise.

C. kinim. "kenim anu itcha" - honesty, together, a word of
justice.
this is another result of A and B. the inteligence of the
nation has reached the maturity that allows it to look
at all parts of it with understanding and respect.
this is the beggining of a strong "gibush" of the nation.

D. arov. "israel arevim ze laze". all parts of the society
help each other. racizm is gone.

E. dever. maybe like daber, talk. communication and florish
of ideas interaction.

F. shchin. "shach kol basar". get-low. low-spirit.
this is the beggining of the breakdown near to comme...
the low-spirit itself is considered a good thing,
style musar. this give a "shine" on the colture.

G. barad. what does that mean ??

H. arbe. "harbe arbe et zar'acha". many. many theories are
developed. this is the peek of the coltural change.
by now, the nation's pride os almost entirely on the newly
developed colture. those concepts, ideas, way of thinking
and all that make this new colture is quite admirable,
but, not stable. it is all too new.

I. choshech. darkness. the beggining of the falldown.
the motivation and wheel that made all those previous
steps posible, the pride of the new colture, are exhausted.
the nation is entring the night period. the period of quiet.
all new ideas are now tested.
the moral is no longer high ( though not low either ).
crime rate is going up, the society is no longer whole and
wheeling to help each other.
yet, nothing bad happened. many are disapointed from the
lake of all the high-spirit and all good things above, but
this is natural.

J. bechorot. falldown. the major, big, old concepts of
democracy, justice, rice-pride, family integrity and honor,
all the "non-modern" yet strong and stabilizing concepts are
no longer respected.
the biggest - oldest - bechorot - ideas are dead.

at this stage, the egyptian colture is alive, and kicking,
but one may say it is not as strong as it were.
israel are now relatively strong enough to start develop
their own uniqueness.
this uniqueness involves, with ideas developed newly by the
egyptians, many of the old, juish concepts.
those concepts, though "unjustice" and non-modern, and
infirier compared to the egyptian colture, are excepted,
since the egypts are dead.
